title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-prep-2026-03-30
body:
Purpose: Quick sync across Serving Runtime, Infra, Console teams - surface risk areas (latency/cost/regressions), unblock rollouts, and agree on action items.

Logistics:
- Time: Mon 2026-03-30 10:00-10:45 PT (30m + 15m buffer)
- Location: Zoom / #eng-serving-runtime channel
- Attendees (prelim): Ava (host), Ravi (infra), Lin (runtime), Sofia (console), Tom (SRE), optional: Priya (product)

Goals for this meeting:
1) Confirm canary rollout schedule for model-fallback changes and SLA smoke-tests.
2) Review last week's latency regressed routes and assign fixes.
3) Decide on telemetry additions for KV-cache cold-start spikes.
4) Triage cost anomaly for Hosted API (embedding batch sizes).

Agenda (timeboxed):
- 10m - Quick updates & blockers (round-robin): each owner 2 mins max (Lin, Ravi, Sofia, Tom)
- 10m - Canary rollout for model-fallback logic (Lin + Ravi)
    - Outline: new fallback policy in runtime v2.3.1; will route >95th percentile latencies to smaller model variant automatically after 300ms
    - PR: github:repo/PR#456 (contains runtime + routing changes)
    - Required infra: reserved nodes for canary (RINF-872) - Ravi to confirm capacity by EOD Mon
    - Risks: inconsistent outputs across variants -> need eval set; console needs to display fallback reason in trace view
- 8m - Latency regressions & KV-cache cold start (Tom + Lin)
    - Observed: spike on route /v1/generate at 2:10am PST 2026-03-29 - tail latency +120ms on p99
    - Hypothesis: cache eviction after kernel update + unusual batch pattern from a single tenant
    - Data needed: per-tenant seq-length distribution and kernel selection logs (Lin to provide sample logs)
- 7m - Cost anomaly: embedding batch sizes driving up token costs (Sofia + Ava)
    - Noted rise: Hosted API embedding unit cost +18% week-over-week (linked analytics)
    - Quick wins: auto-apply batching hints in console, educate customers about recommended batch sizes
- Remaining time - Action items & parking lot

Notes to self / prep checks before meeting:
- Pull canary capacity numbers from infra dashboard; if not green, delay rollout by one week. (Ravi)
- Prepare short demo of console trace showing fallback reason (Sofia) - two screenshots + note on UX copy
- Collect eval prompt-set for fallback acceptance (Ava + applied-ml): choose 50 prompts across generation/structured-output
- Check PR#456 for runtime-side feature flags + how to toggle fallback threshold remotely
- Bring up RINF-910 (observability work) if we need more kernel-level tracing enabled

Open questions to resolve in meeting:
- What is the fallback threshold we want for canary vs GA? (300ms vs 500ms?) -- need product input from Priya
- Should fallback be per-route or per-tenant? early preference: per-route with tenant opt-out
- If fallback changes output semantics for customers, do we require an opt-in/notification window? legal/product may require notice for enterprises

Parking lot (not this meeting unless time):
- Longer discussion on model-variant quality regression guards (post-canary)
- Autoscaling policy for Dedicated pools during black-friday-like traffic

Meeting artifacts to attach after meeting:
- Updated rollout playbook (confluence:SERVE-Runbook-2026)
- PR diff summary for runtime & routing (github:repo/PR#456)
- Short customer-facing note template for enterprise tenants if fallback changes affect outputs

Personal quick checklist (post-meeting):
- Copy minutes to shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/weekly-sync and tag leads
- Create follow-up tickets for any infra capacity shortfalls (JIRA)
- Send 1-paragraph update to product+support if GA schedule changes

Scratchpad (things to potentially say in sync):
- "We observed a tail latency poke tied to KV-cache warmup after the last kernel update - suspect a bad eviction pattern; Lin, can we ship an immediate mitigation (lower eviction aggressiveness) without full rollback?"
- "Sofia, if we show fallback reason in trace, can the console also expose the model variant id the request landed on? that would speed debugging for customers."
- "If Ravi can't guarantee reserved capacity for the canary this week, I'm OK delaying - better to run with capacity and stable SLA checks than risk noisy canary results."
action_items: Ava Martinez - finalize fallback eval prompt-set with Applied ML (50 prompts) - due 2026-04-03
Ravi Patel - confirm reserved canary capacity for runtime v2.3.1 (RINF-872) and post capacity numbers in channel - due 2026-03-30 EOD
Lin Chen - collect kernel selection logs + per-tenant seq-length distribution for the latency spike and upload to shared drive (link in channel) - due 2026-03-31
Sofia Gomez - prepare console trace screenshots showing fallback reason and a short UX copy proposal - due 2026-03-31
Tom Lee - prototype temporary KV-cache eviction tuning (bench + canary) and report perf delta - due 2026-04-02
Ava Martinez - update rollout playbook with canary gating criteria and post to Confluence (SERVE-Runbook-2026) - due 2026-04-01
All - review github:repo/PR#456 and comment on blocking issues before canary (assign owners on PR) - due 2026-03-30
